title: Palindrome checks
summary: Two-pointer palindrome checks, skipping non-alphanumeric characters, and the "delete at most one character" extension.

sections.title: Basic check
sections.body: ✍️ Compare `s[l]` and `s[r]` moving inwards; any mismatch → not a palindrome. O(n) time, O(1) space ([[tp-opposite-ends#palindrome]]).

sections.title: Skipping characters
At most one deletion (LeetCode 680)
sections.body: ✍️ At the first mismatch (l, r), the answer is yes iff `s[l+1..r]` or `s[l..r−1]` is a palindrome. Check both with the basic helper. O(n).

used_by.at: Inner skip loops also check l < r
